name: HSA
summary: HSA is a industrial rotary actuator family integrating a harmonic reducer, motor, encoder and brake. It is intended for compact rotary mechanisms requiring load capacity and positioning control. This listing represents the series.

description.en: HSA is a industrial rotary actuator family integrating a harmonic reducer, motor, encoder and brake. It is intended for compact rotary mechanisms requiring load capacity and positioning control. This listing represents the series.
